name: LocatorAgent
description: Gap-filler agent — assigns CSS locators to intents.yaml entries that don't already have a locator_id, via a live DOM scan. Skips entirely if a URL is unavailable or every intent is already grounded.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: Required to actually run a scan; agent skips without it

outputs.name: intents_newly_grounded
outputs.description: Intents patched with a new locator_id this run
